name: When should I engage a restaurant construction company in my project planning?

mainEntity.name: When should I engage a restaurant construction company in my project planning?

acceptedAnswer.text: It's advisable to engage a restaurant construction company early in your project planning, ideally during the architectural design phase. This allows the contractor to provide valuable input on constructability, cost-saving alternatives, and potential challenges. Early involvement helps ensure that designs are practical and within budget, streamlines the permitting process, and can prevent costly revisions later. A pre-construction phase partnership can lead to a more efficient and successful project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Engage a construction company early, during the architectural design phase, for input on constructability, costs, and to streamline the process.
